scope.target_material: hypothetical complete supplied sequence; no biological name or actual sequence asserted
scope.endpoint: attributable formation of the specified product per amount of source molecule per minute at the source reference assay state
scope.source_inference: positive physical activity versus zero activity
scope.target_inference: conventional support for the same molecular capability using measured correspondence
scope.tree_placement: target lies in the predefined group containing characterized source references rather than the predefined alternative group
scope.site_scope: ten functional sites predefined before the hypothetical target comparison
scope.input_boundary: corrected source activity and propagated variance are upstream derived inputs; correspondence scores/counts and descriptor differences are separately supplied inputs

assay.effect_denominator: minute times amount of assayed source molecule

declared_conventions.sequence_score_requirements: nonnegative local score, nonpositive gap penalties, positive self-substitution scores, s(x,y)<=(s(x,x)+s(y,y))/2, each residue used at most once
declared_conventions.correspondence_combination: available-family arithmetic mean with the five explicitly equal weights

uncertainty.missing_count_reason: not supplied in the inherited synthetic variance summary; not needed for its explicitly fixed-variance arithmetic
uncertainty.native_correspondence_sampling_uncertain: not supplied; no zero error or functional probability inferred
uncertainty.bound_kind: missing-family identification bounds only; not confidence or prediction intervals
uncertainty.system_matrix_role: proposed reference scale, not sampling-error covariance
uncertainty.unquantified_extra_bias_in_real_assays: not established by this synthetic fixture

dependencies.source_assay_block: one supplied upstream finding; six propagated variance components do not create six independent experiments
dependencies.target_correspondence: five possibly dependent measurements; fixed-weight average makes no independence claim
dependencies.comparability_and_isolation: separate components already propagated into source activity and variance; no second quality multiplier
dependencies.source_condition_vs_target_system: declared nonoverlapping quantities in this synthetic fixture
dependencies.duplicate_policy: established original measurement identity is counted once; equality of numeric values alone is insufficient
dependencies.multiple_source_combination: outside this single-source contract; assigned separately
